He co-created MetaMask in 2016 alongside Aaron Davis while at ConsenSys, where he served as a senior engineer and later as a key technical lead. Finlay architected much of MetaMask’s core infrastructure, including its secure key management, transaction signing, and browser-injection model that allows web apps to interact with Ethereum. He also championed user-experience improvements like the seed-phrase backup flow and hardware-wallet integration. Finlay has been a public advocate for self-custody and open standards in the Ethereum ecosystem. He stepped back from day-to-day development around 2022 but remains an advisor.
